scripts.build: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.mkdirSync('dist'); fs.readdirSync('.').forEach(file => { if (fs.statSync(file).isDirectory() && !['node_modules', 'dist', '.git'].includes(file)) { fs.cpSync(file, 'dist/' + file, { recursive: true }); } });"
